
# Load data
```{r}
esviritu_res <- fread(here("data", "Esviritu_HostDiseaseGenometypeV5.tsv"))

#filter the data to contain only human viruses
esviritu_res_human <- esviritu_res[esviritu_res$host_species == "Homo sapiens", ]

sample_metadata <- read.csv(here("data", "samples_metadata.csv"), sep=";", dec=",")
```

# Format the input data - input = read count data
```{r per-sample-taxa-level-RPKMF-df}
count_df <- function(data, tax_level){
  count_df <- data %>%
    group_by(sample_id, !!sym(tax_level)) %>%
    summarize(counts = sum(set_read_count)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  counts_df_wide <- pivot_wider(data=count_df,
                    names_from = sample_id,
                    values_from = counts,
                    values_fill = list(counts=0))

  return(t(counts_df_wide))
}

#same for RPKMF  - for plotting heatmaps later
RPKMF_df <- function(data, tax_level){
  RPKMF_df <- data %>%
    group_by(sample_id, !!sym(tax_level)) %>%
    summarize(RPKMF = sum(true_rpkmf)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  RPKMF_df_wide <- pivot_wider(data=RPKMF_df,
                    names_from = sample_id,
                    values_from = RPKMF,
                    values_fill = list(RPKMF=0))

  return(t(RPKMF_df_wide))
}
```

Taxa level specific read count dataframe - features (species) as columns, samples as rows
```{r}
maaslin_in <- function(data, taxa_level, datatype){
  
  if (datatype=="RPKMF"){
    df_taxa <- RPKMF_df(data, taxa_level)
  } else{
    df_taxa <- count_df(data, taxa_level)
  }
  
  #count_df_taxa <- count_df(data, taxa_level)
  colnames(df_taxa) <- df_taxa[1,]

  df_taxa <- df_taxa[-1, ]

  maaslin_in_abund <- matrix(as.numeric(df_taxa), 
                         nrow = nrow(df_taxa), 
                         ncol = ncol(df_taxa))

    
  # Convert numeric matrix to data frame
  maaslin_in_abund <- as.data.frame(maaslin_in_abund)

  # keep row and column names
  rownames(maaslin_in_abund) <- rownames(df_taxa)
  colnames(maaslin_in_abund) <- colnames(df_taxa)
  
  return(maaslin_in_abund)

}

maaslin_in_hspecies <- maaslin_in(esviritu_res_human, "species", "count")

maaslin_in_species_RPKMF <- maaslin_in(esviritu_res_human, "species", "RPKMF")

#check that the input data looks right
#typeof(maaslin_in_hspecies)
#class(maaslin_in_hspecies)
#str(maaslin_in_hspecies)
maaslin_in_hspecies[1:5,1:5]
maaslin_in_species_RPKMF[1:5,1:5]
```



Format the input metadata file - sample names as row names, metadata as columns

```{r}
rownames(maaslin_in_meta) <- maaslin_in_meta$sample_ID

maaslin_in_meta <- as.data.frame(maaslin_in_meta[,-1])
maaslin_in_meta$reads_in_sample <- as.integer(maaslin_in_meta$reads_in_sample)

#make years 2020-2021 and 2024-2025 a categorical variable
maaslin_in_meta$Year_cat <- ifelse(maaslin_in_meta$Year == "2020" |

                                   "2020-2021", "2024-2025")

maaslin_in_meta
```

Test difference between years

```{r}
set.seed(2025)

human_species_year_input_model <- maaslin3(input_data = maaslin_in_hspecies,
                        input_metadata = maaslin_in_meta,
                        output = 'MaAsLin3_Human_Years',
                        formula = '~ Year_cat + reads_in_sample',
                        normalization = 'TSS',
                        transform = 'LOG',
                        min_prevalence = 3/120, #filter out only rare detections
                        min_abundance = 0, #no filtering based on abundance
                        augment = TRUE,
                        standardize = TRUE,
                        max_significance = 0.1,
                        plot_associations = TRUE,
                        plot_summary_plot = TRUE,
                        median_comparison_abundance = TRUE,
                        median_comparison_prevalence = FALSE,
                        cores = 3)
```

MaAsLin3 does FDR correction over all abundance or prevalence relationships 
(separately). P-values are now adjusted only within the variable of interest,
Year_cat to gain more meaningful results. This is done to abundance and 
prevalence separately, as the default FDR corrections.

Significant results are features that satisfy the following criteria:
(1) re-adjusted qval_individual < 0.10
(2) no errors in model fitting

```{r}
#load all results from maaslin3 run
maaslin_res <- read.table("MaAsLin3_Human_Years/all_results.tsv", header=TRUE, sep="\t")


#adjust abundance and prevalence tests separately, i.e. filter all results based on metadata
signif_abundance <- maaslin_res %>%
  filter(metadata=="Year_cat",
         model=="abundance") %>%
  mutate(qval_individual_readj = p.adjust(pval_individual, method="BH")) %>%
  filter(qval_individual_readj < 0.10,
         is.na(error))

signif_prevalence <- maaslin_res %>%
  filter(metadata=="Year_cat",
         model=="prevalence") %>%
  mutate(qval_individual_readj = p.adjust(pval_individual, method="BH")) %>%
  filter(qval_individual_readj < 0.10,
         is.na(error))
```

## Heatmap of differentially abundant viral species

```{r}
plot_heatmap <- function(data, original_data){
  
  #rename Severe acute respiratory syndrome-related coronavirus to SARS-CoV-2
  #for better plotting readability
  sars_idx <- data$feature == "s__Severe acute respiratory syndrome-related coronavirus"
  data[sars_idx, "feature"] <- "SARS-CoV-2"
  
  sars_idx <- colnames(original_data) == "s__Severe acute respiratory syndrome-related coronavirus"
  colnames(original_data)[sars_idx] <- "SARS-CoV-2"

  
  signif_features <- data %>%
    arrange(coef)
  
  order_vec <- gsub("s__", "", signif_features$feature)
  
  #get the names of significant features, subset the original data based on that
  plot_data <- t(original_data[colnames(original_data) %in% signif_features$feature])
  rownames(plot_data) <- sub("s__", "", rownames(plot_data))
  

  #column annotations
  annot_col <- data.frame(Year = c(rep("2020-2021", 60), rep("2024-2025", 60)))
  rownames(annot_col) <- colnames(plot_data)
  annot_colors_col <- list(Year = c("2020-2021" = "#7B71B6", "2024-2025" = "#E06666"))
  
  #row annotations
  row_annot <- data.frame(Enriched_in= c(rep("hold", nrow(plot_data))))
  rownames(row_annot) <- rownames(plot_data)
  
  
  for (i in c(1:nrow(row_annot))){
    row_annot[i, "Enriched_in"] <- ifelse(data[gsub("s__", "", 
                                                    data$feature) == rownames(row_annot)[i], 
                                               c("coef")] < 0, "2020-2021", "2024-2025")
  }

  annot_colors <- list(Enriched_in = c("2020-2021" = "#7B71B6", "2024-2025" = "#E06666"),
                       Year = c("2020-2021" = "#7B71B6", "2024-2025" = "#E06666"))
   
 
  plot_data <- log2(plot_data+1)
  scale_opt <- "row"
  breaks_opt <- seq(-2, 2, length.out = 101)
  color_opt <- colorRampPalette(c("#3E8A6E", "white", "#F77F00"))(100) #inferno(100)

  #reorder the plot data to get the rows in nice order
  plot_data_reordered <- plot_data[match(order_vec, rownames(plot_data)), , drop = FALSE]
  
  #return(plot_data)
  plot <- pheatmap(plot_data_reordered,
           color = color_opt,
           cluster_rows = FALSE,
           cluster_cols = FALSE,
           show_colnames = FALSE,
           cellheight = 14,
           cellwidth = 3,
           fontsize = 14,
           scale = scale_opt,
           annotation_col = annot_col,
           annotation_row = row_annot,
           annotation_colors = annot_colors,
           annotation_names_row = FALSE,
           breaks = breaks_opt)

  return(plot)
  
}

```

```{r}
hm_DP_species <- plot_heatmap(signif_prevalence, maaslin_in_species_RPKMF)
hm_DP_species
```

## Quadrant plot of signficant MaAsLin results 

A summary quadrant plot of MaAsLin results shows viral traits, with the x-axis indicating acute versus persistent viruses and the y-axis indicating pathogenic versus commensial classification; red denotes viruses more prevalent and abundant in 2020–2021 and violet in 2024–2025, while point size reflects the q-value.

```{r}
pathogenic_comm_species <-  fread(here("data", "Human_data.tsv"))

pathogenic_comm_species <- unique(pathogenic_comm_species[, c("species", "subspecies","Life-style")])
colnames(pathogenic_comm_species) <- c("species","subspecies", "Life_style")

acute_persistent_species <- fread(here("MaAsLin3_significant_species_Acute_Persistent_Unknown.txt"), sep=",", header=FALSE)

colnames(acute_persistent_species) <- c("feature", "inf_type")


signif_all <- rbind(signif_abundance, signif_prevalence)

#signif_all_annot <- merge(signif_all, pathogenic_comm_species,
#                          by.x="feature", by.y="species", all.x = FALSE,
#                            all.y=FALSE) %>%
#                        distinct() %>%
#                    merge(., acute_persistent_species, by.x="feature", by.y="feature") %>%
#                    distinct()

#write.csv(signif_all_annot[, c("feature","subspecies", "Life_style", "inf_type")], row.names = FALSE,
#           "MaAsLin3_significant_species_annotations.tsv")






```

Load the annotations made for significant species, life-style and infection types,
match those to species name.
```{r}
signif_all <- rbind(signif_abundance, signif_prevalence)

signif_species_annot <-  fread(here("data", "MaAsLin3_significant_species_annotations.tsv"))


signif_all_annot <- merge(signif_all, signif_species_annot,
                          by="feature", all.x = FALSE, all.y=FALSE) %>%
                    distinct()

```

Filter only the relevant information for quadrant plot plotting. Filter the data
to contain only the lifestyles and infection types that are of interest, then 
in case of multiple results per feature, choose the one with the smallest FDR 
corrected q-value and teh corresponding coef and annotations to represent that.
```{r}
quadrant_plot_data <- signif_all_annot %>%
  filter(Life_style=="Pathogenic" | Life_style=="Commensal",
         inf_type=="Acute" | inf_type=="Persistent") %>% 
  group_by(feature) %>%
  arrange(qval_individual) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  summarize(coef=coef,
            qval_individual_readj = qval_individual_readj,
            Life_style=Life_style,
            inf_type=inf_type) 
  
```

create quadrant figure from the persistent/acute and commensial/pathogenic axis
    
    pathogenic   a     |    b
    -------------------------------
    commensial   c     |    d
               acute      persistent

```{r}
#calculate the features belonging to each category

a <- quadrant_plot_data %>%
  filter(Life_style=="Pathogenic",
         inf_type=="Acute") 
  
b <- quadrant_plot_data %>%
  filter(Life_style=="Pathogenic",
         inf_type=="Persistent")

c <- quadrant_plot_data %>%
  filter(Life_style=="Commensal",
         inf_type=="Acute")

d <- quadrant_plot_data %>%
  filter(Life_style=="Commensal",
         inf_type=="Persistent")

nrow(a)
nrow(b)
nrow(c)
nrow(d)
```
IDEA kuvan tekemiseen:

valmistele jokaiselle ruudulle oma grid ja niiden koordinaatti yhdistelmät
(vaikka 1000 pistettä per ruutu)

ja sitten niistä koordinaattipareista valitse randomilla nrow(ruudun lajit)
```{r}
make_template_grid <- function(k, xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, margin = 0.1) {
  stopifnot(k >= 2)
  xrange <- xmax - xmin
  yrange <- ymax - ymin
  
  # shrink box by margin percentage
  xmin2 <- xmin + margin * xrange
  xmax2 <- xmax - margin * xrange
  ymin2 <- ymin + margin * yrange
  ymax2 <- ymax - margin * yrange
  
  xs <- seq(xmin2, xmax2, length.out = k)
  ys <- seq(ymin2, ymax2, length.out = k)
  grid <- expand.grid(x = xs, y = ys)
  grid
}


```

Generate 10,000 possible coordinates for each panel

```{r}
k <- 20
margin=0.08
a_coords <- make_template_grid(k, xmin = -1, xmax =  0, ymin =  0, ymax = 1, margin = margin)
b_coords <- make_template_grid(k, xmin =  0, xmax =  1, ymin =  0, ymax =  1, margin = margin)
c_coords <- make_template_grid(k, xmin = -1, xmax =  0, ymin = -1, ymax =  0, margin = margin)
d_coords <- make_template_grid(k, xmin =  0, xmax =  1, ymin = -1, ymax =  0, margin = margin)

```


Then randomly sample right number of coordinates for each panel

```{r}
#set.seed(5)
set.seed(5)
a_sample <- a_coords[sample(nrow(a_coords), nrow(a)), , drop = FALSE]
a$x <- a_sample$x
a$y <- a_sample$y

b_sample <- b_coords[sample(nrow(b_coords), nrow(b)), , drop = FALSE]
b$x <- b_sample$x
b$y <- b_sample$y
set.seed(1234)
c_sample <- c_coords[sample(nrow(c_coords), nrow(c)), , drop = FALSE]
c$x <- c_sample$x
c$y <- c_sample$y

d_sample <- d_coords[sample(nrow(d_coords), nrow(d)), , drop = FALSE]
d$x <- d_sample$x
d$y <- d_sample$y

a$category <- "pathogenic_acute"
b$category <- "pathogenic_persistent"
c$category <- "commensal_acute"
d$category <- "commensal_persistent"

data_all <- rbind(a,b,c,d)
data_all$qval_size <- 1/(data_all$qval_individual_readj)

data_all$more_abundant_in <- ifelse(data_all$coef < 0, "2020-2021", "2024-2025")
```


```{r}
quadrant <- ggplot(data_all) +
  geom_point(aes(x=x, y=y, size=(-log10(qval_individual_readj)*abs(coef)), 
                 color=more_abundant_in)) +
  scale_color_manual(values= c("2020-2021" = "#7B71B6", "2024-2025" = "#E06666")) +
                     #labels=c("2020-2021", "2024-2025"))+
  labs(x="", y="") +
  theme_bw()  +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(-0.5, 0.5),
                   labels=c("Acute","Persistent")) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(-0.5, 0.5),
                   labels=c("Commensal", "Pathogenic")) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth=1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth=1.5) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black",angle=90, hjust=0.5, vjust=0.5),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color="black", linewidth=2),
        text = element_text(family = "Arial", size=20, color="black"))
```
